subject: Trial kickoff: prompt/log collection, evaluation plan & success matrix
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <sgupta@finqore.com>, Priya Menon <priya@finqore.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial kickoff: prompt/log collection, evaluation plan & success matrix

Hi Samir / Priya —

Great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can start the trial next week: 

What we heard (high level)
- Primary use case: automated extraction + classification for customer support tickets, prioritizing urgency labels and entity extraction for SLA routing.
- Target latency: p95 < 2s for 1k token requests; throughput target during peak bursts ~50 r/s.
- Success definition: accuracy on entity extraction > 88% (per token exact match), label F1 > 0.85 vs your ground truth, and average inference cost <= $0.012/1k tokens.

What we need from you to begin the POC
1) A representative prompt set / historical logs export (~800-1,200 prompts) with anonymized PHI removed. Prefer CSV with columns: prompt_id, user_text, context_metadata (json-string), expected_label, expected_entities. (See attached sample CSV.)
2) A small golden-label set (100–200 examples) for evaluation and calibration.
3) Your preferred timeline: you mentioned ~4 weeks for a meaningful trial — please confirm.
4) Primary POC owner on your side and technical contact for S3 access.

Proposed Redwood plan and roles- Redwood will: ingest prompt set, run baseline eval across two recommended model variants, produce per-prompt scoring (exact match / token-level metrics), human review flags, and a one-page success matrix at the end of week 2 and week 4.- Internal owners: Rishi will lead eval pipelines and model selection; Priyom will own data transfer and privacy checklist.

Next calls- Technical kickoff (30–45m) with Rishi & Priyom: options Thu 2028-08-24 09:00-10:00 PT or Fri 2028-08-25 11:00-11:45 PT. Please confirm which works.

Attachments: sample CSV template attached (finqore_prompt_samples_20280822.csv) and our POC eval template (redwood_poc_eval_template.xlsx).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199

---

From: Samir Gupta <sgupta@finqore.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@finqore.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: prompt/log collection, evaluation plan & success matrix

Thanks Kim — good recap. Quick confirmation and answers below.

Data delivery
- I attached a small export (finqore_prompt_samples_20280822.csv) with 1,050 anonymized prompts. Columns should match what you requested. We also dropped a golden set of 150 labeled examples in the S3 path below. We removed direct PHI per our legal guidelines.
- S3 path: s3://finqore-prod/pocs/redwood/2028-08-22/ (we gave redwood-poc-readonly role to redwood-infra@redwood-iam). Please confirm you can access it.

Success criteria tweaks
- We like your suggested matrix. One note: for entity extraction, we care more about recall for critical entities (account_id, ticket_id) than token-level exact match. Can we add a weighted recall metric (weight critical entities x2)?
- Cost goal: target <$0.015/1k tokens to account for longer conversation contexts.

Timeline and owners
- Four-week trial works for us. Proposed milestones: Week 1 data ingest & baseline, Week 2 tuned runs + human spot-check, Week 3 canary with near-prod traffic (sampled), Week 4 final eval and handoff.
- POC owner: Priya Menon (priya@finqore.com) — exec sponsor: Anil Rao (anil.rao@finqore.com). Technical lead: me.

Availability for kickoff
- Thu 2028-08-24 09:00 PT works for our team.

Attachments: I attached the small CSV excerpt. Please confirm receipt.

Best,
Samir
Head of ML Platforms, FinQore Analytics
sgupta@finqore.com
